{"id":2003237260,"question_id":2892,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"2 months, 1 week","timestamp":1778783345,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"3 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2003237260/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Check if Array is Good","memory":"27.5 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    bool isGood(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        unordered_map<int , int>mp;\n\n        for(auto it : nums) mp[it]++;\n        int maxi = *max_element(begin(nums) , end(nums));\n\n        if(n != (maxi + 1)) return false;\n        for(auto it : mp)\n        {\n            if(it.first != maxi) \n            {\n                if(it.second > 1) return false;\n            }\n            else if(it.second != 2) return false;\n        }\n        return true;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"check-if-array-is-good","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1998}
